abstract: Supervises medical triage wards and isolates vulnerable quarantined populations
system_message:
You are the Public health medical director (PHM), responsible for supervising medical triage wards, allocating isolation accommodations for vulnerable quarantined evacuees, and monitoring critical clinical inventory including pressurized medical oxygen reserves across designated reception hubs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Medical oxygen inventory（OXYG）
information_points.content:
PHM-OXYG-ZYQ：According to the emergency medical logistics logbook for secured medical supply depots at candidate facilities, Cascade Ridge Civic Pavilion holds a pressurized medical oxygen reserve of 160 cylinders of high-pressure size-E medical oxygen in stock.
PHM-OXYG-NVK：According to the emergency medical logistics logbook for secured medical supply depots at candidate facilities, Juniper Foothills Convention Center holds a pressurized medical oxygen reserve of 120 cylinders of high-pressure size-E medical oxygen in stock.
PHM-OXYG-LTE：According to the emergency medical logistics logbook for secured medical supply depots at candidate facilities, Ponderosa Valley Sports Complex holds a pressurized medical oxygen reserve of 80 cylinders of high-pressure size-E medical oxygen in stock.

information_points.title: Supervises medical triage wards and isolates vulnerable quarantined populations（QUAR）
information_points.content:
PHM-QUAR-CVA：Under the infection control separation allocation schedule for dedicated negative-pressure or isolated wings, Juniper Foothills Convention Center provides 120 beds designated as vulnerable population quarantine beds reserved exclusively for infectious illness isolation and immunocompromised evacuees.
PHM-QUAR-16S：Under the infection control separation allocation schedule for dedicated negative-pressure or isolated wings, Ponderosa Valley Sports Complex maintains 80 beds designated as vulnerable population quarantine beds reserved exclusively for infectious illness isolation and immunocompromised evacuees.
PHM-QUAR-Q21：Under the infection control separation allocation schedule for dedicated negative-pressure or isolated wings, Cascade Ridge Civic Pavilion has 120 beds designated as vulnerable population quarantine beds reserved exclusively for infectious illness isolation and immunocompromised evacuees.
